title: DOWNED WASH LIGHTER, ONE RED ACCENT
why: Critic on screen 34 (3 of 5): the red wash tints the whole HUD and three red elements stack on the card. The wash drops from 45 to 30 percent and the bleed bar goes neutral.
now: The red tint while downed is lighter and the card keeps red only on the label and the slider.

edits.replacement: ctx.fillStyle='rgba(60,8,5,.30)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);   // v34.40 (cw-downedcard3), critic on screen 34 (P1 'the heavy red wash tints every HUD colour'): the downed wash is 30 percent, was 45, so the HUD keeps its contrast

bar(W/2-100,_barY,200,10,p.downT/CFG.downTime,UIC.tx_2);   // v34.40 (cw-downedcard3), critic on screen 34 (P1 'three red elements stacked, use one accent per card'): the bleed bar is neutral, the danger red stays on the label and the slider
